name: Lanes board: a declared lane wait state beside the checkpoint and one bounded lanes read
summary: One declared wait state beside a checkpoint and one bounded read that flags a stale wait. The checkpoint command accepts an optional sibling lane_state key, and the writer posts a reserved Kind: lane-state-v1 record beside it: the checkpoint object is unchanged, its field set stays closed, and an older kit reads it as ordinary text. Fields: schema_version 1, task, state (working, waiting-on-coordinator, waiting-on-review, waiting-on-user, idle), waiting_on (a role or an actor id; required with a waiting state, refused without it; nobody is inferred) and an optional expect_by (ISO-8601 with an offset; a past value is accepted and flagged, an unparseable one refused). work lanes [--idle-minutes N] reads ONE native export plus the session registry with no per-task comment read: one row per lane keyed by the session's registered name, the held tasks with review_state/whose_move/next_actor/work_state from work.move_decision, the declared state and checkpoint age, and the waiting_too_long, expect_by_passed and your_move_idle flags. A lane that holds nothing and wrote within 24 hours is idle. Bounded with total/items/next_offset; the contributor route shows only the caller's own row.
